```plato
    //==
    // # Inverse trigonometric functions
    //
    // The public, `Angle`-returning surface over the `*Radians` intrinsics.
    // Each is a partial function: the arc- family requires its argument to be
    // in the domain of the corresponding forward function (`Acos` and `Asin`
    // need [-1, 1]; `Acosh` needs >= 1; `Atanh` needs (-1, 1)).
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inverse_trigonometric_functions

    // The angle whose cosine is `self`, in [0, pi]. Precondition: -1 <= self <= 1.
    Acos(self: Number): Angle
        => new Angle(self.AcosRadians);
```
